description: Bilingual strings of the ArkDeck App surfaces the Windows client shows (TASK-XPA-007). An entry with a table is the macOS App's entry of the same key in ArkDeckApp/Resources/<table>.xcstrings, values unchanged; an entry whose table is null exists on Windows only (a Windows surface with no macOS counterpart, such as the daemon-unavailable recovery banner). windows/scripts/generate-ui-strings.py writes the Windows .resw files from this file and keeps the .xcstrings entries equal to it; --check fails on any drift.

entries.en: Adoption (durable binding) is performed from the CLI: arkdeck device adopt. This App does not submit adoption.
entries.zh-Hans: 接管（建立持久绑定）由 CLI 执行：arkdeck device adopt。本 App 不提交接管操作。

entries.en: Nothing needs attention in the current diagnostics.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前诊断中没有需要处理的事项。

entries.en: Runtime history could not be read
entries.zh-Hans: 无法读取 Runtime 记录

entries.en: No recent runs yet. Start from a workflow in the sidebar.
entries.zh-Hans: 还没有最近运行，请从左侧工作流开始。
正在加载 Runtime 历史
无法读取 Runtime 历史

entries.en: Start or reconnect ArkDeck Runtime, then refresh the history.
entries.zh-Hans: 请启动或重新连接 ArkDeck Runtime，然后刷新历史记录。

entries.en: ArkDeck Runtime has recorded no Jobs on this host.
entries.zh-Hans: ArkDeck Runtime 在本机尚未记录任何 Job。

entries.en: History only reads Runtime state. Opening a related tool never submits, cancels, or retries this Job.
entries.zh-Hans: History 只读取 Runtime 状态。打开相关工具不会提交、取消或重试此 Job。
正从已确认安全边界恢复

entries.en: Start or reconnect ArkDeck Runtime, then refresh jobs.
entries.zh-Hans: 启动或重新连接 ArkDeck Runtime，然后刷新 Job。

entries.en: Runtime is reachable and has no recorded jobs.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 可访问，但尚未记录任何 Job。

entries.en: The device effect is unknown. Do not treat this Job as finished.
entries.zh-Hans: 设备影响未知。不要把此 Job 视为已经完成。

entries.en: Runtime stopped at a human-required boundary.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 已停在需要人工处理的边界。

entries.en: Enter 1–64 characters. This name is shown only in ArkDeck; it does not change the device identity or binding.
entries.zh-Hans: 请输入 1–64 个字符。此名称仅用于 ArkDeck 中显示，不会修改设备标识或绑定关系。

entries.en: Select a Job to inspect its details. The planned / simulated marker stays with a job permanently, in History and in any export.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择一个 Job 以查看详情。planned / simulated 标识永久跟随 Job，包括历史与导出。
正在加载 Job 详情

entries.en: Outcome unknown — this Job's effect on the device was never confirmed.
entries.zh-Hans: 结果未知——此 Job 对设备的影响从未被确认。

entries.en: Waiting for a person to act.
No Artifacts were recorded for this Job.
entries.zh-Hans: 此 Job 未记录 Artifact。

entries.en: No captured artifacts: a planned job carries only its plan record, by design.
entries.zh-Hans: 无采集产物：planned Job 按设计只含计划记录。

entries.en: Artifact bytes are read in bounded verified chunks. The selected destination stays in the App and is never sent to Runtime.
entries.zh-Hans: Artifact 字节通过有界分块读取并校验；所选保存位置仅留在 App 内，不会发送给 Runtime。
检查 Artifact 导出信息

entries.en: Customize ArkDeck and review build identity, platform information, and privacy guarantees.
entries.zh-Hans: 自定义 ArkDeck，并查看构建身份、平台信息与隐私保证。

entries.en: Session artifacts stay in the configured local storage root unless you explicitly export them.
entries.zh-Hans: 除非你主动导出，否则 Session 产物始终保存在已配置的本地存储目录。
不会自动上传诊断信息

entries.en: Crashes and Job failures never create or upload a diagnostic bundle automatically.
entries.zh-Hans: 崩溃或任务失败都不会自动生成或上传诊断包。

entries.en: Inspect the selected HDC executable and its verified server context.
entries.zh-Hans: 检查当前选中的 HDC 可执行文件及其已验证的服务端上下文。

entries.en: Manage the Session root, quota and retention window, and read what each store is actually holding.
entries.zh-Hans: 管理 Session 根目录、配额与保留周期，并查看每个存储实际占用了多少。

entries.en: These are the bytes ArkDeck Runtime stores for Jobs. Runtime measures and enforces this quota itself; the policy above applies to the Session output root instead.
entries.zh-Hans: 这里是 ArkDeck Runtime 为任务保存的 Artifact 字节。该配额由 Runtime 自行计量与执行；上方的策略作用于 Session 输出根，不作用于这里。

entries.en: ArkDeck Runtime did not report its artifact usage, so no figure is shown here.
entries.zh-Hans: ArkDeck Runtime 未报告 Artifact 用量，因此这里不显示数字。

entries.en: The quota, safety margin and retention window above apply to this root only. Runtime artifacts are stored separately and are not counted here.
entries.zh-Hans: 上方的配额、安全余量与保留周期只作用于这个根目录。Runtime Artifact 单独存放，不计入这里。

entries.en: Retention cleanup never deletes pinned Sessions.
entries.zh-Hans: 保留策略清理绝不会删除已固定的 Session。

entries.en: Current usage is unavailable. The saved quota and retention policy remain visible above.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前用量不可用；已保存的配额与保留策略仍显示在上方。

entries.en: Cancellation requested. Runtime is reaching a safe boundary; wait for its terminal state.
entries.zh-Hans: 已请求取消。Runtime 正在到达安全边界，请等待最终状态。

entries.en: Cancellation was not confirmed. Refresh the record before trying again.
entries.zh-Hans: 取消请求未确认。请刷新记录后重试。

entries.en: Review the recorded reason and evidence before continuing through an approved Runtime path.
entries.zh-Hans: 请先检查已记录的原因和证据，再通过已批准的 Runtime 路径继续。

entries.en: Choose the entry HAP first. Add up to 16 feature HAPs or HSPs from the same bundle; all packages are installed together. Each file must be 1 byte–64 MiB.
entries.zh-Hans: 先选择入口 HAP，再添加同一 Bundle 的 feature HAP 或 HSP，最多 16 个，所有包一起安装。每个文件为 1 字节至 64 MiB。

entries.en: Capture bounded HiLog while the app runs
entries.zh-Hans: 应用运行时采集有界 HiLog

entries.en: Names are validated against the Catalog schema; they are never interpreted as arguments.
entries.zh-Hans: 名称按 Catalog schema 校验，绝不会被解释为命令参数。
正在校验并导入安装包…

entries.en: The current target probe returned no package names.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前目标探测未返回应用包名。

entries.en: The App checks and imports every package in bounded chunks before submitting one Job. Local paths never cross into Runtime.
entries.zh-Hans: App 会先逐个校验并分块导入所有安装包，再提交一个 Job。本地路径不会进入 Runtime。

entries.en: Install, start, stop, uninstall, and remote staging are device mutations. Every dispatch must bind the durable target revision and consume matching authority.
entries.zh-Hans: 安装、启动、停止、卸载与远端暂存均为设备变更。每次 dispatch 必须绑定持久设备 revision 并消费匹配授权。
设备变更影响范围明确可见

entries.en: Runtime is executing the typed HAP lifecycle…
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 正在执行 typed HAP 生命周期…

entries.en: Uninstall after run removes the app, so it cannot stay running. Choose Retain installed app to keep observing it.
entries.zh-Hans: 运行后卸载会移除应用，无法保持运行。要继续观察应用，请选择“保留已安装应用”。

entries.en: Each package can be selected only once. Remove the duplicate selection.
entries.zh-Hans: 同一个安装包只能选择一次，请移除重复选择。

entries.en: The selected file could not be read.

entries.zh-Hans: 请选择一个 .hap 入口包。

entries.en: Choose .hap or .hsp files with basenames containing letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens.
entries.zh-Hans: 请选择 .hap 或 .hsp 文件，文件名仅含字母、数字、点、下划线或连字符。

entries.en: Choose one entry .hap. Use a basename with letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens.
entries.zh-Hans: 请选择一个 .hap 入口包，文件名仅含字母、数字、点、下划线或连字符。
附加安装包最多可选 16 个。

entries.en: Read from the signed ELF during validation
entries.zh-Hans: 校验时从已签名 ELF 自动读取

entries.en: Use a dotted bundle name such as com.example.app.
entries.zh-Hans: 请输入 com.example.app 形式的 Bundle 名称。

entries.en: Name the owning app and library. Runtime derives the app-owned device destination from the published profile; this page never accepts a remote path.
entries.zh-Hans: 填写所属应用与动态库名称。Runtime 根据已发布 profile 推导 app-owned 设备目标位置；此页面不接受远端路径。

entries.en: Use a lib<name>.so filename with no directory components.
entries.zh-Hans: 请输入不含目录的 lib<name>.so 文件名。

entries.en: Deployment did not reach verified completion
entries.zh-Hans: 部署未达到验证完成状态

entries.en: Runtime plan is ready for review
The Native Debug path always verifies the published hash, restarted process, and loaded-library maps. Any failed verification automatically restores and re-verifies the previous library.
entries.zh-Hans: Native Debug 路径始终验证发布 hash、重启后的进程与动态库加载 maps；任一验证失败都会自动恢复并复验旧动态库。

entries.en: Validating the signed ELF and materializing the Runtime plan…
entries.zh-Hans: 正在校验已签名 ELF 并生成 Runtime 计划…

entries.en: Each Job deploys one signed app-owned .so through the published operation. Queues run these Jobs serially, stopping on failure or uncertainty. ELF, ABI, Build ID, hash, backup and readback checks still apply. .abc replacement and standalone device restart remain unavailable.
entries.zh-Hans: 每个 Job 通过已发布 operation 部署一个已签名 app-owned .so；队列串行运行，失败或结果不确定时停止。仍执行 ELF、ABI、Build ID、hash、备份与读取验证。.abc 替换和独立设备重启仍不可用。

entries.en: The artifact was selected, but its server could not be bound to this target.
entries.zh-Hans: 远端产物已选择，但无法把该服务器绑定到当前目标。

entries.en: Browse folders below the verified build root. Only lib*.so files are shown.
entries.zh-Hans: 浏览已验证编译根目录以内的文件夹；这里只显示 lib*.so 文件。

entries.en: Add and verify an SSH server in Settings > Servers first.
entries.zh-Hans: 请先在“设置 > 服务器”中添加并验证 SSH 服务器。

entries.en: No folders or native libraries here
entries.zh-Hans: 此处没有文件夹或动态库

entries.en: Validation must complete before the plan can be submitted. The reviewed plan digest pins the exact target, binding, Artifact lease, inputs, and step sequence.
entries.zh-Hans: 校验完成后才能提交计划。已检查的 plan digest 会固定精确 target、binding、Artifact lease、输入和步骤序列。

entries.en: Restore and verify the previous library on failure
entries.zh-Hans: 失败时恢复并复验旧动态库

entries.en: Runtime is deploying and verifying the library
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 正在部署并验证动态库

entries.en: Waiting for the next durable Runtime stage.
entries.zh-Hans: 正在等待下一个持久化 Runtime 阶段。

entries.en: Back up, replace, restart, and verify

ABI and signature validation block incompatible input before device writes. Runtime backs up the current library, publishes atomically, restarts the owning Ability, and requires loaded-library maps. Any failed verification automatically restores and re-verifies the previous library.
entries.zh-Hans: ABI 与签名校验会在设备写入前阻止不兼容输入。Runtime 随后备份当前动态库、原子发布、重启所属 Ability，并要求动态库加载 maps；任一验证失败都会自动恢复并复验旧动态库。

entries.en: Choose signed app-owned libraries from local files, folders, mounted SMB shares or a verified SSH build source. Only selected bytes enter Artifact import.
entries.zh-Hans: 从本地文件、文件夹、已挂载 SMB 共享或已验证 SSH 构建源选择已签名的 app-owned 动态库；只有所选字节进入 Artifact 导入。

entries.en: Folder access uses the file-picker grant. SMB shares must already be mounted in Finder. SSH, including WSL, stays read-only within the saved root and pins the host key.
entries.zh-Hans: 文件夹访问使用文件选择器授权；SMB 共享需先在 Finder 挂载。SSH（包括 WSL）在已保存根目录内只读访问，并固定主机密钥。

entries.en: Library published, Ability restarted, and loaded state verified
entries.zh-Hans: 动态库已发布，Ability 已重启，加载状态已验证

entries.en: Verify hash, process, and loaded maps
entries.zh-Hans: 验证 hash、进程与已加载 maps
正在检查 Runtime 可用性…

entries.en: The operation descriptor is missing from this build. Nothing can be prepared.
entries.zh-Hans: 此构建缺少 operation descriptor，无法准备任何请求。

entries.en: No published Runtime operation exposes device buffer mutation. Normal capture never clears, resizes, or flushes it.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前没有已发布 Runtime operation 提供设备 buffer 变更；普通采集绝不会清空、扩容或 flush。

entries.en: No published Runtime operation starts, stops, or uninstalls an individual package. Use the typed HAP lifecycle above.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前没有已发布 Runtime operation 可以启动、停止或卸载单个应用；请使用上方的 typed HAP 生命周期。

entries.en: Only the provider may lower this typed input into executable + argv after Runtime admission. The Job's derived report discloses that lowering; the UI never guesses or concatenates a shell command.
entries.zh-Hans: 只有 provider 可在 Runtime 准入后将此 typed input 降级为 executable + argv。Job 的派生报告会披露 lowering；UI 不猜测也不拼接 shell 命令。
没有已发布的模板 Artifact

entries.en: Run an approved template to publish its bounded output and report.
entries.zh-Hans: 运行 approved 模板后，Runtime 会发布有界输出与报告。

entries.en: The App submits approved typed templates only through debug.template@1. Runtime records the request as a durable Job and publishes bounded Artifacts.
entries.zh-Hans: App 只通过 debug.template@1 提交 approved typed template。Runtime 会把请求记录为持久 Job，并发布有界 Artifact。

entries.en: There is no free-text command, argv or path field; PTY and raw shell do not belong to this surface.
entries.zh-Hans: 不存在自由文本 command / argv / path 字段；PTY 与 raw shell 不属于此界面。
Debug 模板 Job 正在运行

entries.en: No PTY, password prompt, sudo, or interactive session
entries.zh-Hans: 不提供 PTY、密码提示、sudo 或交互会话

entries.en: This template declares no user parameters.
Runtime could not finalize all artifacts. Review the Job details.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 无法完成全部 Artifact。请检查 Job 详情。

entries.en: Runtime could not publish an execution artifact. Review the Job details.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 无法发布执行 Artifact。请检查 Job 详情。

entries.en: The operation stopped at a safe boundary.
entries.zh-Hans: 操作已在安全边界停止。

entries.en: The operation did not run. Runtime proof is required before another request.
entries.zh-Hans: 操作未执行。提交另一个请求前必须取得 Runtime 证明。

entries.en: Execution failed. Review this Job’s artifacts and diagnostics.
entries.zh-Hans: 执行失败。请检查此 Job 的 Artifact 和诊断信息。

entries.en: Runtime was interrupted. Review the Job before continuing.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 已中断。继续前请检查此 Job。

entries.en: The operation failed. Review the Job timeline and artifacts.
entries.zh-Hans: 操作失败。请检查 Job timeline 和 Artifact。

entries.en: The device effect is unknown. Keep the device unchanged while Runtime reconciles it.
entries.zh-Hans: 设备影响未知。Runtime 核对期间请保持设备状态不变。

entries.en: Runtime confirmed that the operation did not complete. Submit another typed request only after Runtime permits it.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 已确认操作未完成。仅在 Runtime 允许后提交新的 typed 请求。

entries.en: These actions modify global device logging state and require separate capability checks, confirmation, and audit.
entries.zh-Hans: 这些操作会修改设备全局日志状态，必须单独进行能力检查、确认与审计。

entries.en: Artifact bytes are read in bounded verified chunks; the save location is handled only by the App and is never sent to Runtime.
entries.zh-Hans: Artifact 字节通过有界分块读取并校验；保存位置只由 App 处理，不会发送给 Runtime。
检查 Artifact 导出信息

entries.en: Invalid typed value in: %@. Use letters, numbers, dot, underscore, colon, or hyphen only.
entries.zh-Hans: 以下 typed 值无效：%@。仅可使用字母、数字、点、下划线、冒号或连字符。

entries.en: Every filter is a bounded typed token. Free shell fragments are never accepted.
entries.zh-Hans: 每项筛选都是有界 typed token，不接受任何自由 shell 片段。

entries.en: A Runtime capture can publish bounded shards and a manifest. Pausing this viewport would never stop host capture.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 采集可发布有界分片与 manifest；暂停此视图绝不会停止 host 采集。

entries.en: The viewport can pause only while a capture is running; pausing never stops host capture.
entries.zh-Hans: 仅在采集进行中才能暂停界面；暂停绝不停止 host 采集。
保存 raw HiLog Artifact（必需）

entries.en: Completed shards appear here in manifest order with exact size and hash.
entries.zh-Hans: 已完成分片将按 manifest 顺序显示精确大小与 hash。
已发布 operation 总输出预算：%@

entries.en: Deletion must name the exact rule and durable target binding
entries.zh-Hans: 删除必须明确指定规则与持久目标设备 binding

entries.en: The current Runtime publishes no operation for reading forward/reverse rules.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前 Runtime 未发布读取 forward/reverse 规则的 operation。

entries.en: Every create/delete operation binds one durable target revision
entries.zh-Hans: 每个新建/删除操作绑定一个持久目标设备 revision

entries.en: No shell fragments, schemes, hosts, or flags are accepted
entries.zh-Hans: 不接受 shell 片段、scheme、host 或 flag

entries.en: Only decimal TCP ports from 1024 through 65535 are accepted
entries.zh-Hans: 仅接受 1024 到 65535 的十进制 TCP 端口
请输入十进制 Host 端口。

entries.en: Host port must be from 1024 through 65535.
entries.zh-Hans: Host 端口必须在 1024 到 65535 之间。
请输入十进制设备端口。

entries.en: Device port must be from 1024 through 65535.
entries.zh-Hans: 设备端口必须在 1024 到 65535 之间。

entries.en: Both ports are valid typed values.
entries.zh-Hans: 两个端口均为有效 typed 值。

entries.en: Typed Artifact deployment, logs, app lifecycle, network rules, and approved read-only tools — never a raw terminal.
entries.zh-Hans: Typed 产物部署、日志、应用生命周期、网络规则和 approved 只读工具——绝非 raw terminal。

entries.en: %@ accepts only letters, digits and . _ : - — the value never reaches a shell.
entries.zh-Hans: %@ 只接受字母、数字和 . _ : -；该值绝不会进入 shell。

entries.en: If a partition write is in progress, Runtime finishes that critical step and stops only at the next safe boundary.
entries.zh-Hans: 若正在写入分区，Runtime 会完成该临界步骤，仅在下一个安全边界停止。
AVAILABLE — Runtime 可生成 flash.full-restore@1 计划
正在检查 Runtime 可用性

entries.en: Availability describes the production Runtime. Preparing a preview never submits or runs an operation.
entries.zh-Hans: 可用性来自生产 Runtime。生成预览不会提交或执行任何操作。

entries.en: The selected board matches one adopted Runtime target, while another board is still the active Flash binding. Click Flash once; Runtime will re-read the unique USB identity, atomically activate only the exact selected target, refresh prerequisites, and stop before any write if those facts drift.
entries.zh-Hans: 所选开发板精确匹配一个已采用的 Runtime 目标，但另一台设备仍是当前刷机绑定。只需点击一次刷机；Runtime 会重新读取唯一 USB 身份，仅原子激活精确选中的目标并刷新前置条件；若事实发生漂移，将在任何写入前停止。
所选 DAYU200 需要切换为当前绑定

entries.en: Loader is bound to the selected device
entries.zh-Hans: Loader 已绑定到所选设备

entries.en: ArkDeck found one DAYU200 in Loader mode, but it is not yet linked to a durable target. Select the device, then click Flash once; Runtime will bind the Loader, refresh the exact plan, and continue only if every prerequisite passes.
entries.zh-Hans: ArkDeck 已发现一台处于 Loader 模式的 DAYU200，但它尚未关联到持久设备。请选择该设备，然后只需点击一次刷机；Runtime 会绑定 Loader、刷新精确计划，并仅在全部前置条件通过后继续。

entries.en: DAYU200 is already in Loader mode
entries.zh-Hans: DAYU200 已进入 Loader 模式

entries.en: ArkDeck found the selected DAYU200 in Loader mode, but its historical binding needs a fresh Runtime attestation. Click Flash once; Runtime will re-attest the selected Loader, refresh the exact plan, and continue only if every prerequisite passes.
entries.zh-Hans: ArkDeck 已发现所选 DAYU200 处于 Loader 模式，但其历史绑定需要由 Runtime 重新核验。只需点击一次刷机；Runtime 会重新核验所选 Loader、刷新精确计划，并仅在全部前置条件通过后继续。
正在检查 RockUSB 设备访问

entries.en: Use the supported DAYU200 Loader device shown above, then re-check.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择上方受支持的 DAYU200 Loader 设备，然后重新检查。

entries.en: Have the device or tool vendor inspect the controlled probe diagnostics.
entries.zh-Hans: 请设备或工具供应方检查受控探测诊断。

entries.en: Reconnect the board or put it into Loader mode, then re-check.
entries.zh-Hans: 重新连接开发板或让其进入 Loader 模式，然后重新检查。

entries.en: Ask the device or tool vendor to repair the host USB driver or libusb backend outside ArkDeck, then re-check.
entries.zh-Hans: 请设备或工具供应方在 ArkDeck 外修复主机 USB 驱动或 libusb backend，然后重新检查。

entries.en: Ask a system administrator to grant this user access to the RockUSB device outside ArkDeck, then re-check.
entries.zh-Hans: 请系统管理员在 ArkDeck 外为当前用户授予 RockUSB 设备访问权限，然后重新检查。

entries.en: Host driver or libusb backend is unavailable
entries.zh-Hans: 主机驱动或 libusb backend 不可用

entries.en: The registered probe returned unknown output
entries.zh-Hans: 已注册探测返回未知输出

entries.en: Device is offline or not in Loader mode
entries.zh-Hans: 设备离线或未进入 Loader 模式
主机权限拒绝 RockUSB 访问

entries.en: A device was found, but it is not a supported DAYU200 Loader target
entries.zh-Hans: 已发现设备，但它不是受支持的 DAYU200 Loader 目标

entries.en: Unable to read the selected file. Select the image bundle again.
entries.zh-Hans: 无法读取所选文件，请重新选择镜像包。
请选择 .tar.gz、.zip 或 .7z 格式的镜像压缩包。

entries.en: Choose a complete, valid DAYU200 image archive.
entries.zh-Hans: 请选择完整且有效的 DAYU200 镜像压缩包。

entries.en: Unable to materialize the exact plan. Review the detail below.
entries.zh-Hans: 无法生成精确计划，请查看下方详情。

entries.en: Unable to read the image bundle. Select it again.
entries.zh-Hans: 无法读取镜像包，请重新选择。

entries.en: This image bundle does not match the selected DAYU200 profile.
entries.zh-Hans: 此镜像包与所选 DAYU200 配置不匹配。

entries.en: Prepare an exact execute plan before flashing.
entries.zh-Hans: 刷机前请先生成精确执行计划。

entries.en: Required Runtime prerequisites are unknown or not satisfied. Keep the intended DAYU200 connected, prepare its cross-mode binding, then prepare the exact plan again.
entries.zh-Hans: 必需的 Runtime 前置条件未知或未满足。请保持目标 DAYU200 连接，完成跨模式绑定后重新生成精确计划。
计划将覆盖 %d 个已映射分区。

entries.en: Orphan images, unmapped partitions, and sector gaps remain untouched.
entries.zh-Hans: 孤立镜像、未映射分区和扇区间隙均不会被写入。

entries.en: userdata is overwritten; existing user data is destroyed.
entries.zh-Hans: userdata 将被覆盖，现有用户数据会被清除。

entries.en: Materialized by Runtime at submission (recorded on the job)
entries.zh-Hans: 提交时由 Runtime 物化（记录于任务）

entries.en: Not previewable yet: this bundle has never entered the lane store; it becomes previewable after its first flash
entries.zh-Hans: 暂不可预览：该镜像包尚未进入 lane 存储；首刷之后即可预览

entries.en: This runtime has no ArkForge lane composed
entries.zh-Hans: 当前 Runtime 未组合 ArkForge lane
正在向 arkforged 请求预物化……
arkforged 拒绝给出可执行计划

entries.en: Reading, hashing, and validating the image bundle…
entries.zh-Hans: 正在读取、哈希并校验镜像包……

entries.en: Profile prerequisites are listed once an exact plan exists.
entries.zh-Hans: 生成精确计划后展示 profile 前置条件。

entries.en: These are the latest read-only Runtime observations. Unknown is never upgraded by the App; Runtime verifies every required prerequisite again before a critical write.
entries.zh-Hans: 以下为 Runtime 最新只读探测结果。App 不会把 unknown 猜成满足；Runtime 会在临界写入前再次验证全部必需前置条件。

entries.en: Writing a partition — this critical step cannot be interrupted. Stopping only prevents later steps. Do not close the lid, sleep the Mac, disconnect power, or unplug the device.
entries.zh-Hans: 正在写入分区——临界区不可中断；停止只会阻止后续步骤。请勿合盖、手动睡眠、断电或拔线。
尚无 Runtime 刷机 Job

entries.en: Preparing or confirming a local plan does not create a Job. Authorized Runtime execution will appear here.
entries.zh-Hans: 在本地生成或确认计划不会创建 Job；经授权的 Runtime 执行会显示在这里。

entries.en: The old device effect remains unknown. Runtime will automatically recognize or run an exact complete-overwrite recovery when proof is sufficient; a user confirmation cannot override missing proof.
entries.zh-Hans: 旧设备影响仍然未知。证明充分时，Runtime 会自动识别或执行精确的完整覆写恢复；用户确认不能绕过缺失的证明。

entries.en: Read only: this card cannot cancel, retry, reconcile, or resume.
entries.zh-Hans: 只读：此卡片不能取消、重试、核对或恢复执行。

entries.en: A Runtime Flash job needs attention
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 刷机 Job 需要处理

entries.en: Runtime reports cancellation. Review the last confirmed stage before disconnecting the device.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 报告已取消。断开设备前，请核对最后确认的阶段。

entries.en: Runtime reports failure. Use the Job record to find the last confirmed stage before recovery.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 报告失败。开始恢复前，请从 Job 记录确认最后完成的阶段。

entries.en: Runtime is still processing this Job. Progress is stage-based; no percentage is fabricated.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 仍在处理此 Job。进度按真实阶段展示，不生成虚假百分比。

entries.en: Runtime reports an interruption. Open the Job record before deciding the device state.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 报告执行中断。判断设备状态前，请打开 Job 记录。

entries.en: Runtime stopped at a non-overridable safety blocker. This page cannot supply missing device-state proof.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 已停在不可绕过的安全阻塞处。此页面不能补足缺失的设备状态证明。

entries.en: Device effect is unknown. Do not treat this Job as finished or start another flash.
entries.zh-Hans: 设备影响未知。不要把此 Job 视为完成，也不要开始下一次刷机。

entries.en: Plan-only Job completed. No device mutation was dispatched.
entries.zh-Hans: 仅计划 Job 已完成，未派发设备变更。

entries.en: Runtime reports success after the Flash and postflight checks.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 报告刷机及 postflight 检查成功。

entries.en: This Job's outcome remains unknown, but a later confirmed complete-overwrite recovery established the current target state.
entries.zh-Hans: 此 Job 的结果仍未知，但后续已确认的完整覆写恢复已建立当前目标状态。

entries.en: This Job's outcome remains unknown, but a later confirmed full Flash proved its target was an alias and established the current device state.
entries.zh-Hans: 此 Job 的结果仍未知，但后续已确认的完整刷机证明其目标是别名，并建立了当前设备状态。

entries.en: Runtime returned an unfamiliar state. Open the record before deciding what to do.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 返回了未知状态。决定下一步前，请打开记录。

entries.en: An unreadable history is not an empty history. Refresh after Runtime becomes reachable.
entries.zh-Hans: 无法读取历史不等于历史为空。Runtime 恢复可达后请刷新。

entries.en: Runtime stopped for an operator decision. Open the Job record and follow its exact recovery instruction; confirmation on this page cannot resume it.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 已停下等待操作员决定。请打开 Job 记录并遵循其精确恢复指引；此页面的确认不能恢复执行。
等待设备重新绑定确认
正在通过完整覆写恢复

entries.en: Ready to resume at a confirmed boundary
Connect and adopt a DAYU200 in ArkDeck Runtime, then refresh this workspace.
entries.zh-Hans: 请先在 ArkDeck Runtime 中连接并接管 DAYU200，然后刷新此工作区。

entries.en: The historical target is not available. Select a current target explicitly to prepare a new plan; refreshing never switches devices for a historical run.
entries.zh-Hans: 历史目标当前不可用。请显式选择当前目标后准备新计划；刷新不会替历史运行切换设备。
没有可用的已接管目标

entries.en: This click acknowledges the shown impact. Runtime still rechecks the exact target, image, plan, and prerequisites before any device effect.
entries.zh-Hans: 此次点击仅表示知晓上方影响；任何设备副作用前，Runtime 仍会重新校验精确目标、镜像、计划与前置条件。

entries.en: %d required safety check(s) are unknown or not satisfied. Flash remains blocked.
entries.zh-Hans: %d 项必需安全检查未知或未满足，刷机保持阻断。
将擦除 %@ 上的用户数据。

entries.en: Keep the device connected and on stable power. Do not close the Mac during flashing.
entries.zh-Hans: 请保持设备连接和稳定供电，刷机期间不要合盖。

entries.en: Choose a .tar.gz, .zip, or .7z DAYU200 image archive
entries.zh-Hans: 请选择 .tar.gz、.zip 或 .7z 格式的 DAYU200 镜像压缩包

entries.en: Validating the image and materializing the exact plan…
entries.zh-Hans: 正在校验镜像并生成精确计划…
进入 Loader 与身份绑定

entries.en: Waiting for the next confirmed Runtime progress boundary.
entries.zh-Hans: 正在等待 Runtime 回报下一个已确认的进度节点。

entries.en: Do not unplug, power off, or close the Mac. The current partition write will not be force-stopped.
entries.zh-Hans: 请勿拔线、断电或合盖；当前分区写入不会被强制中断。

entries.en: %d/%d partitions completed · current partition %d%% · image write %d%%
entries.zh-Hans: 已完成 %d/%d 个分区 · 当前分区 %d%% · 镜像写入总进度 %d%%
正在等待设备重新连接

entries.en: Runtime is validating the selected image and device facts
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 正在校验所选镜像与设备事实

entries.en: Choose an image to run the exact safety checks
entries.zh-Hans: 选择镜像后执行精确安全检查

entries.en: Connect and adopt one DAYU200 target
entries.zh-Hans: 请连接并接管一台 DAYU200 目标

entries.en: The exact plan could not be materialized
Runtime finished with state: %@. The device is not shown as successfully flashed.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 以状态 %@ 结束；设备不会显示为刷机成功。

entries.en: The device reconnected and its reported build and binding match the selected image and exact plan.
entries.zh-Hans: 设备已重新连接，回报构建版本与绑定均与所选镜像及精确计划一致。

entries.en: Runtime did not provide complete postflight proof. The device is not shown as successfully flashed.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 未提供完整的刷写后证明；设备不会显示为刷机成功。

entries.en: Choose an image and start flashing. During the run, the page focuses on progress; when done, it shows the result.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择镜像后开始刷机；进行中只突出进度，完成后直接显示结果。

entries.en: This device's hitrace category list is not supported by this ArkDeck version. Update ArkDeck or use a supported device.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前 ArkDeck 版本尚未支持此设备的 hitrace 分类列表。请更新 ArkDeck 或使用已支持的设备。

entries.en: The default trace buffer is unavailable for this device.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前设备不支持默认 Trace 缓冲区。

entries.en: Trace capability check is incomplete for this device. Refresh and try again.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前设备的 Trace 能力检查尚未完成，请刷新后重试。

entries.en: Wait for the device check to finish.
Enter a duration inside the allowed range.
entries.zh-Hans: 请输入允许范围内的时长。

entries.en: Trace capture is unavailable. Refresh and try again.
entries.zh-Hans: Trace 抓取暂不可用，请刷新后重试。

entries.en: This profile is not supported by the selected device. Choose another profile.
entries.zh-Hans: 所选设备不支持这个抓取场景，请选择其他场景。

entries.en: Unable to cancel this capture. Wait for the current safe step to finish and try again.
entries.zh-Hans: 无法取消此次抓取。请等待当前安全步骤结束后重试。

entries.en: The trace stays on this Mac and opens automatically.
entries.zh-Hans: Trace 只保存在这台 Mac，并会在完成后自动打开。

entries.en: Capture ended without a viewable trace. Open History for details.
entries.zh-Hans: 抓取已结束，但没有可查看的 Trace。请打开历史记录了解详情。

entries.en: Capture outcome is unknown. Check History before starting another capture.
entries.zh-Hans: 抓取结果未知。再次抓取前请先查看历史记录。

entries.en: Best for slow interactions, layout work and ArkUI jank.
entries.zh-Hans: 适合分析交互迟缓、布局耗时和 ArkUI 卡顿。

entries.en: Captures the broadest system activity and produces the largest trace.
entries.zh-Hans: 覆盖最广的系统活动，生成的 Trace 也最大。

entries.en: Best for file, storage and work-queue investigations.
entries.zh-Hans: 适合分析文件、存储和工作队列问题。

entries.en: Best for frame production, graphics and animation issues.
entries.zh-Hans: 适合分析出帧、图形和动画问题。

entries.en: Best for thread scheduling, contention and IPC investigations.
entries.zh-Hans: 适合分析线程调度、资源争用和 IPC 问题。

entries.en: No adopted devices. Connect and adopt a device, then refresh.
entries.zh-Hans: 没有已接管的设备。请连接并接管设备，然后刷新。
请输入 %1$d 到 %2$d 之间的值。

entries.en: Capture completed, but no valid raw trace was published. Open History to inspect the job.
entries.zh-Hans: 抓取已完成，但没有发布有效的原始 Trace。请打开历史记录检查任务。

entries.en: Capture completed, but its trace is unavailable. Refresh and try opening it again.
entries.zh-Hans: 抓取已完成，但 Trace 暂不可用。请刷新后重试。

entries.en: Open a local trace or choose a recent trace in the viewer.
entries.zh-Hans: 在查看器中打开本地 Trace，或继续查看最近的 Trace。
最新抓取的 Trace 已就绪

entries.en: Verifying and opening the captured trace…
entries.zh-Hans: 正在校验并打开抓取的 Trace…

entries.en: Capture completed, but the trace could not be read. Refresh and try again.
entries.zh-Hans: 抓取已完成，但无法读取 Trace。请刷新后重试。

entries.en: Unable to prepare the trace for viewing. Check available storage and try again.
entries.zh-Hans: 无法准备要查看的 Trace。请检查可用存储空间后重试。

entries.en: Capture a trace from an adopted OpenHarmony device, then inspect it in the built-in viewer.
entries.zh-Hans: 从已接管的 OpenHarmony 设备抓取 Trace，然后在内置查看器中分析。

entries.en: Select this tab to capture componentDetail fields
entries.zh-Hans: 选择此标签以采集 componentDetail 字段

entries.en: Capture View creates a typed Runtime Job and shows only verified, same-Job Artifacts.
entries.zh-Hans: 「抓取视图」会创建一个 typed Runtime Job，并且只展示同一个 Job 里通过校验的 Artifact。

entries.en: Select an adopted target with a complete binding, then capture the view.
entries.zh-Hans: 先选择一个绑定完整的已纳管目标，再抓取视图。

entries.en: %1$@ cannot capture a view: %2$@. Select a Connected target.
entries.zh-Hans: %1$@ 无法抓取视图：%2$@。请选择一个「已连接」的目标。

entries.en: Use the UI tree to select a component with the keyboard.
entries.zh-Hans: 用 UI 树可以通过键盘选择组件。

entries.en: The tree bounds do not prove this screenshot's coordinate space. Tree and Raw dump remain available, but screenshot selection is disabled.
entries.zh-Hans: 树的 bounds 无法证明这张截图的坐标系。树和 Raw dump 仍然可读，但截图选择已禁用。

entries.en: Resize UI tree and node properties
entries.zh-Hans: 调整 UI 树和节点属性的高度

entries.en: UI tree uses %1$d percent of the inspector

entries.zh-Hans: 搜索组件 / ID / 文本

entries.en: No matching components. The current selection is unchanged.
entries.zh-Hans: 没有匹配的组件。当前选中项未改变。
搜索找到至少 %lld 个结果
Trace 已加载，有 %lld 个可见轨道
Trace 已加载，没有带时刻的事件

entries.en: The derived trace cache needs attention. Inspect it in Trace settings; the original trace is not a cache target.
entries.zh-Hans: Trace 派生缓存需要处理。请在 Trace 设置中检查；原始 Trace 不属于缓存清理范围。

entries.en: Opening was cancelled. No new trace was opened.
entries.zh-Hans: 打开操作已取消，没有打开新的 Trace。

entries.en: The source could not be read or validated. Choose an accessible trace file.
entries.zh-Hans: 源文件无法读取或校验。请选择一个可访问的 Trace 文件。

entries.en: The trace operation did not finish. Review the diagnostic details and the available recovery action.
entries.zh-Hans: Trace 操作未完成。请查看诊断详情和当前可用的处理方式。

entries.en: The bundled parser could not be verified or started. Check the diagnostic details before retrying.
entries.zh-Hans: 内置解析器未通过校验或无法启动。请查看诊断详情后重试。

entries.en: The local ArkDeck Runtime is not running or did not answer.
entries.zh-Hans: 本机的 ArkDeck Runtime 未运行或没有应答。

entries.en: The local endpoint is served by a process that is not the installed ArkDeck Runtime, so nothing was sent to it.
entries.zh-Hans: 本机端点由一个不是已安装 ArkDeck Runtime 的进程提供，因此没有向它发送任何内容。

entries.en: The running ArkDeck Runtime speaks another control contract than this app.
entries.zh-Hans: 正在运行的 ArkDeck Runtime 使用的控制契约与本 App 不同。

entries.en: This copy of ArkDeck has no installed ArkDeck Runtime identity to verify, so it did not connect.
entries.zh-Hans: 此 ArkDeck 副本没有可供校验的已安装 ArkDeck Runtime 身份，因此没有连接。

entries.en: Start the ArkDeck Runtime, then retry: any arkdeck command that needs it starts it, and arkdeck doctor shows what is wrong.
entries.zh-Hans: 请启动 ArkDeck Runtime 后重试：任何需要它的 arkdeck 命令都会启动它，arkdeck doctor 会说明问题所在。

entries.en: Quit whatever holds the endpoint, then start ArkDeck again; arkdeck doctor reports the held name.
entries.zh-Hans: 请退出占用该端点的程序，然后重新启动 ArkDeck；arkdeck doctor 会报告被占用的名称。

entries.en: Install matching ArkDeck app and Runtime versions, then start ArkDeck again.
entries.zh-Hans: 请安装版本匹配的 ArkDeck App 与 Runtime，然后重新启动 ArkDeck。

entries.en: Install ArkDeck with its Runtime, or set ARKDECK_DAEMON_PATH with ARKDECK_DAEMON_SIGNER_SHA256 or ARKDECK_DAEMON_PACKAGE_FAMILY, then retry.
entries.zh-Hans: 请安装带 Runtime 的 ArkDeck，或设置 ARKDECK_DAEMON_PATH 以及 ARKDECK_DAEMON_SIGNER_SHA256 或 ARKDECK_DAEMON_PACKAGE_FAMILY，然后重试。

entries.en: Runtime diagnostics could not be read
entries.zh-Hans: 无法读取 Runtime 诊断
%1$lld 个阻断 · %2$lld 个警告 · %3$lld 条信息

entries.en: Scripted daemon "%@": nothing on this window comes from ArkDeck Runtime.
entries.zh-Hans: 脚本化 daemon “%@”：此窗口中的内容均不来自 ArkDeck Runtime。

entries.en: No device has been adopted yet.

entries.zh-Hans: 无法读取已接管的目标

entries.en: Select an adopted target to see its details.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择一个已接管的目标以查看详情。
接管时的 HDC 版本
在文件资源管理器中显示

entries.en: The Trace viewer is not available on Windows yet: the Runtime inspects the Trace, and Export… saves it for another tool.
entries.zh-Hans: Windows 版暂不提供 Trace 查看器：Trace 由 Runtime 检查，可用“导出…”保存后在其他工具中打开。

entries.en: What the ArkDeck Runtime reports about itself, and the CLI commands that control it.
entries.zh-Hans: ArkDeck Runtime 自身报告的信息，以及控制它的 CLI 命令。
已配置 · 已接管 %lld 台

entries.en: Status, verification and restart of the Runtime run in the CLI. The App only reads the Runtime through its authenticated pipe; it never starts, stops or replaces it.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 的状态、校验与重启在 CLI 中执行。App 只通过经过认证的管道读取 Runtime，从不启动、停止或替换它。

entries.en: Signing credentials are held by the Runtime in Windows Credential Manager and are never shown here; read their status with the CLI.
entries.zh-Hans: 签名凭据由 Runtime 保存在 Windows 凭据管理器中，此处从不显示；请用 CLI 查看其状态。
无法读取 HDC 状态

entries.en: The derived Trace cache the Runtime keeps; the original Traces are never cache entries.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 维护的 Trace 派生缓存；原始 Trace 从不属于缓存条目。
无法读取 Trace 缓存状态
%1$lld 个条目 · %2$lld 个活跃 · %3$lld 个非活跃

entries.en: Workspace projects and presets registered with the Runtime. Registering and changing them runs in the CLI; the project roots stay with the Runtime.
entries.zh-Hans: 已向 Runtime 登记的工作区项目与预设。登记和修改在 CLI 中执行；项目根目录只由 Runtime 保存。

entries.en: Select a project to see its presets.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择一个项目以查看其预设。

entries.en: No preset is registered for this project.
The Sessions the Runtime keeps on this PC: pin the ones to keep, export one, or clean up what the retention policy allows.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 在这台电脑上保存的 Session：固定要保留的，导出某一个，或清理保留策略允许清理的。

entries.en: Select a Session to see it.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择一个 Session 以查看详情。

entries.en: Pinned: retention cleanup never removes it.
entries.zh-Hans: 已固定：保留清理不会移除它。

entries.en: Unpinned: retention cleanup may remove it when it expires.
entries.zh-Hans: 已取消固定：到期后保留清理可以移除它。
检查 Session 导出信息

entries.en: The Runtime writes Session %1$@ to the new folder %2$@ (about %3$@). Device identifiers: %4$@. Sensitive Artifacts are not included.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 会把 Session %1$@ 写入新文件夹 %2$@（约 %3$@）。设备标识：%4$@。不包含敏感 Artifact。

entries.en: Removes %1$lld Sessions and reclaims %2$@ (from %3$@ to %4$@). Pinned Sessions are kept.
entries.zh-Hans: 将移除 %1$lld 个 Session，回收 %2$@（从 %3$@ 降至 %4$@）。已固定的 Session 会保留。

entries.en: Nothing to clean up: the retention policy keeps every Session.
entries.zh-Hans: 无需清理：保留策略会保留所有 Session。
已移除 %1$lld 个 Session，回收 %2$@。

entries.en: Runtime stops Job %@ at its next safe boundary. A step already writing to the device finishes first.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 会在下一个安全边界停止 Job %@。已经在写设备的步骤会先完成。
%1$lld 个 Artifact，%2$lld 个已校验 · %3$lld 个清理项

entries.en: The agent executions the Runtime runs and the human actions they wait on. Starting an agent stays in the CLI.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 运行的 Agent 执行，以及它们正在等待的人工操作。启动 Agent 仍在 CLI 中进行。
无法读取 Agent 执行
当前没有等待中的人工操作。
当前没有 Agent 执行记录。

entries.en: Select an agent execution to see it.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择一个 Agent 执行以查看详情。

entries.en: The outcome is unknown: check the device before running it again.
entries.zh-Hans: 结果未知：再次运行前请先检查设备。

entries.en: Choose one of the listed values first.

entries.zh-Hans: 已继续：Runtime 会接着执行。
放弃这个 Agent 执行？

entries.en: The Runtime stops agent execution %1$@ (generation %2$@). It cannot be resumed afterwards.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 会停止 Agent 执行 %1$@（代次 %2$@），之后不能再继续。

entries.en: The agent execution was not abandoned
Files uploaded to the Runtime and published as Artifacts for an adopted Target. Each file is checked, sent in verified chunks and published by the Runtime.
entries.zh-Hans: 上传到 Runtime、并作为某个已接管 Target 的 Artifact 发布的文件。每个文件都会先检查，再分块校验发送，最后由 Runtime 发布。

entries.en: No Target is adopted: adopt one in the CLI first.
entries.zh-Hans: 尚未接管任何 Target：请先在 CLI 中接管。

entries.en: Upload cancelled; the partial Import was aborted.
entries.zh-Hans: 已取消上传；未完成的导入已中止。

entries.en: Select an Import to see it.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择一个导入以查看详情。

entries.en: The Runtime releases Import %1$@ (generation %2$@). A Job can no longer use its Artifact.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 会释放导入 %1$@（代次 %2$@），之后 Job 不能再使用它的 Artifact。
请先选择一个已接管的 Target。

entries.en: Complete the fields above with valid values first.
entries.zh-Hans: 请先用有效值填写上面的字段。

entries.en: The Runtime cannot run this operation now; the reasons are shown above.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 当前无法运行此操作，原因见上方。

entries.en: A Job of this tab is running; wait for it or stop it first.
entries.zh-Hans: 此标签页有 Job 正在运行；请等待其结束或先停止它。

entries.en: Keep the device connected and on stable power. Do not shut down, sleep or unplug the PC during flashing.
entries.zh-Hans: 请保持设备连接和稳定供电，刷机期间不要关机、睡眠或拔掉电脑电源。

entries.en: Do not unplug, power off, or put the PC to sleep. The current partition write will not be force-stopped.
entries.zh-Hans: 请勿拔线、断电或让电脑睡眠，当前分区写入不会被强行中断。

entries.en: Writing a partition — this critical step cannot be interrupted. Stopping only prevents later steps. Do not put the PC to sleep, disconnect power, or unplug the device.
entries.zh-Hans: 正在写入分区——此关键步骤不可中断，停止只会阻止后续步骤。请勿让电脑睡眠、断电或拔线。
请选择 .tar.gz、.zip 或 .7z 镜像压缩包。

entries.en: The selected target changed; the exact plan is prepared again.
entries.zh-Hans: 所选 Target 已变更，将重新准备精确计划。

entries.en: Capture a trace from a connected OpenHarmony device
entries.zh-Hans: 从已连接的 OpenHarmony 设备采集 Trace

entries.en: Open, drop, or choose a recent .htrace/.ftrace/.systrace file.
entries.zh-Hans: 打开或拖入 .htrace/.ftrace/.systrace 文件，也可选择最近打开的文件。

entries.en: Select an event or drag a time range.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择事件或拖动选取时间范围。

entries.en: No ArkTrace parser is distributed for Windows, so this PC cannot draw the timeline. The file's size and SHA-256 are shown; for a captured Trace, the Runtime's Trace inspector is asked.
entries.zh-Hans: Windows 版未分发 ArkTrace 解析器，本机无法绘制时间线。此处显示文件大小和 SHA-256；对于采集得到的 Trace，会询问 Runtime 的 Trace 检查器。
请选择 .htrace、.ftrace、.systrace 或 .trace 文件。

entries.en: The trace stays on this PC and opens automatically.
entries.zh-Hans: Trace 只保存在这台 电脑，并会在完成后自动打开。

entries.en: This component has no numeric hostWindowId/componentId pair in the current capture
entries.zh-Hans: 当前采集中，此组件没有数字形式的 hostWindowId/componentId 组合

entries.en: This restores the selected record's read-only context. Any new action creates a new Job; the historical Job is never replayed.
entries.zh-Hans: 这里恢复的是所选记录的只读上下文。任何新操作都会创建新的 Job，不会重放历史 Job。
诊断会话采集尚不可用

entries.en: Interactive arm, append-marker and stop controls are not connected. Open a saved bounded capture from History, or use Trace and Debug › Logs to capture.
entries.zh-Hans: 交互式布防、追加标记和停止尚未接通。可从 History 打开已保存的有界采集，或使用 Trace 与 Debug › Logs 采集。

entries.en: Marks are host time. Without a calibration nothing here can be lined up against what the device recorded.
entries.zh-Hans: 标记走的是主机时间。没有校准，这里的任何东西都无法与设备记录的内容对齐。

entries.en: Nothing was marked in this session.
entries.zh-Hans: 这次会话没有任何标记。

entries.en: These marker kinds were never derived, so their absence says nothing about the run.
entries.zh-Hans: 这些标记种类从未被反推，所以它们的缺席不说明这次运行发生了什么。

entries.en: This session is missing a product it declared.
entries.zh-Hans: 这次会话缺少它自己声明过的产物。

entries.en: the cursor has left this event
Only a time point is selected
Open a capture.diagnostics Job from History to read its verified artifacts. No connected device is needed to read a saved capture.
entries.zh-Hans: 从 History 打开 capture.diagnostics 记录，读取校验后的产物。读取已保存的采集无需连接设备。

entries.en: A screenshot stands for the moment it was taken, not the moment it was asked for.
entries.zh-Hans: 截图只代表拍摄时刻，不代表标记时刻的画面。
这一时刻没有可证明对应的画面

entries.en: The nearest screenshot is too far from this mark to stand for it.
entries.zh-Hans: 最近的一张截图距这个标记太远，不能代表它。

entries.en: A screenshot was taken around this mark, but the interval it could have been taken in is wider than the tolerance, so it cannot be said to be this moment.
entries.zh-Hans: 这个标记附近确有一张截图，但它可能被拍摄的时间区间宽于容差，因此无法断定它就是这一时刻。

entries.en: Saved capture · read only. Viewing does not start a new Job.
entries.zh-Hans: 已保存的采集 · 只读。查看不会启动新 Job。

entries.en: Runtime found the coverage anchor in the ring snapshot.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 已在环形快照中找到覆盖锚点。

entries.en: The ring snapshot lost its coverage anchor. Earlier events may be missing.
entries.zh-Hans: 环形快照未保留覆盖锚点，较早事件可能缺失。

entries.en: Text previews stay in this App. Sensitive content is read only when you select it; nothing is exported or uploaded.
entries.zh-Hans: 文本预览仅留在此 App。敏感内容仅在选择后读取，不会导出或上传。

entries.en: A published Trace can open in Trace Viewer. Other files can be exported explicitly from History. Job times are never used as screenshot timestamps.
entries.zh-Hans: 已发布的 Trace 可在 Trace Viewer 打开；其他文件可从 History 显式导出。不会使用 Job 时间推算截图时刻。

entries.en: Preview shows the first 120,000 characters. Export the artifact from History to read the complete file.
entries.zh-Hans: 预览显示前 120,000 个字符。可从 History 导出产物以读取完整文件。
在 Viewer 中打开敏感 Trace

entries.en: Reads the selected Job’s immutable Trace into the local viewer cache. No upload.
entries.zh-Hans: 将所选 Job 的不可变 Trace 读取到本机查看器缓存，不上传。

entries.en: Some bytes are not valid UTF-8 and appear as � in this preview. The original Artifact and its SHA-256 are unchanged.
entries.zh-Hans: 部分字节不是有效 UTF-8，在此预览中显示为 �。原始 Artifact 及其 SHA-256 未改变。

entries.en: This structured text is not valid UTF-8. Inspect or export the original Artifact from History.
entries.zh-Hans: 这份结构化文本不是有效 UTF-8。请在 History 中检查或导出原始 Artifact。

entries.en: Unable to verify the HiLog summary
entries.zh-Hans: 无法核验 HiLog 摘要

entries.en: Return to History to inspect this Job and its Artifacts. Reload to try reading the same record again.
entries.zh-Hans: 请返回 History 检查此 Job 与 Artifact；重新加载只会重读同一记录。

entries.en: Read-only view of the saved summary. Opening or reloading it does not run another analysis.
entries.zh-Hans: 只读查看已保存的摘要。打开或重新加载不会再次执行分析。
全部非空行的行首已识别

entries.en: These counts describe default HiLog line headers only. They do not prove capture completeness, valid body encoding, absence of faults or device health.
entries.zh-Hans: 这些统计仅描述默认 HiLog 行首；不证明采集完整、正文编码有效、没有故障或设备健康。

entries.en: The source Artifact ID matches the Job input. The source hash and size are recorded by the analyzer; this view does not read the raw log or verify it again. Export the summary from History.
entries.zh-Hans: 来源 Artifact 标识与 Job 输入一致。来源哈希与大小来自分析器记录；此页面不会读取或重新核验原始日志。可从 History 导出摘要。

entries.en: ArkDeck will only browse below the verified build root and import a selected lib*.so file.
entries.zh-Hans: ArkDeck 只会浏览已验证编译根目录以内的内容，并导入选中的 lib*.so 文件。

entries.en: Add an SSH server before browsing remote build artifacts in Debug.
entries.zh-Hans: 先添加 SSH 服务器，随后即可在 Debug 中浏览远端编译产物。

entries.en: New password (leave empty to use Keychain)
entries.zh-Hans: 新密码（留空则使用 Keychain）

entries.en: The private key could not be read. Choose the file again.
entries.zh-Hans: 无法读取该私钥，请重新选择文件。

entries.en: Choose a non-empty OpenSSH private key no larger than 256 KiB.
entries.zh-Hans: 请选择不超过 256 KiB 的非空 OpenSSH 私钥。

entries.en: The server profile and its Keychain credential will be removed from this Mac.
entries.zh-Hans: 服务器配置及其 Keychain 凭据将从这台 Mac 上移除。
固定 SSH 主机密钥

entries.en: The first verified fingerprint is saved explicitly. A changed host key is rejected on every later connection.
entries.zh-Hans: 首次验证的指纹需显式保存；后续连接若主机密钥变化将直接拒绝。

entries.en: Imported secrets stay in Keychain. System default reads only owner-private id_rsa and id_ed25519 files; secrets never enter profiles, logs, command lines, or Runtime XPC.
entries.zh-Hans: 导入的凭据只存入 Keychain；系统默认仅只读当前用户私有的 id_rsa 与 id_ed25519，秘密不会进入配置、日志、命令行或 Runtime XPC。

entries.en: ArkDeck exposes no SSH command, shell, upload, delete, rename, or arbitrary path API.
entries.zh-Hans: ArkDeck 不开放 SSH 命令、Shell、上传、删除、重命名或任意路径接口。

entries.en: Manage SSH servers used to browse and import remote build artifacts.
entries.zh-Hans: 管理用于浏览和导入远端编译产物的 SSH 服务器。

entries.en: If no file is selected, ArkDeck tries ~/.ssh/id_rsa, then ~/.ssh/id_ed25519. SSH config, known_hosts, and other files are not read.
entries.zh-Hans: 不选择文件时，ArkDeck 依次尝试 ~/.ssh/id_rsa、~/.ssh/id_ed25519；不会读取 SSH config、known_hosts 或其他文件。

entries.en: Test connection and inspect host key
entries.zh-Hans: 测试连接并检查主机密钥
正在通过 SSH/SFTP 连接……

entries.en: Review this fingerprint. Saving will trust this exact host key for later connections.
entries.zh-Hans: 请核对该指纹；保存后只信任这一枚主机密钥。

entries.en: The saved Keychain credential will be used for this test.
entries.zh-Hans: 本次测试将使用 Keychain 中已保存的凭据。

entries.en: Connection, credential, SFTP root, and host key verified
entries.zh-Hans: 连接、凭据、SFTP 根目录与主机密钥均已验证

entries.en: Choose a remote artifact in Debug to bind a verified server to this target.
entries.zh-Hans: 在 Debug 中选择远端产物后，会把已验证服务器绑定到当前目标。

entries.en: The bound server was removed. Choose another remote artifact in Debug.
entries.zh-Hans: 已绑定的服务器已被删除，请在 Debug 中重新选择远端产物。

entries.en: Imported secrets stay in Windows Credential Manager. System default reads only owner-private id_rsa and id_ed25519 in %USERPROFILE%\.ssh; secrets never enter profiles, logs, command lines, or Runtime calls.
entries.zh-Hans: 导入的密钥仅保存在 Windows 凭据管理器中。系统默认仅读取 %USERPROFILE%\.ssh 中仅所有者可访问的 id_rsa 与 id_ed25519；密钥不会进入配置文件、日志、命令行或 Runtime 调用。

entries.en: New password (leave empty to use Credential Manager)
entries.zh-Hans: 新密码（留空则使用凭据管理器中的密码）

entries.en: The saved Credential Manager credential will be used for this test.
entries.zh-Hans: 本次测试将使用凭据管理器中已保存的凭据。

entries.en: The server profile and its Credential Manager credential will be removed from this PC.
entries.zh-Hans: 将从此电脑移除该服务器配置及其凭据管理器中的凭据。

entries.en: If no file is selected, ArkDeck tries %USERPROFILE%\.ssh\id_rsa, then id_ed25519. SSH config, known_hosts, and other files are not read.
entries.zh-Hans: 未选择文件时，ArkDeck 依次尝试 %USERPROFILE%\.ssh\id_rsa 与 id_ed25519。不会读取 SSH 配置、known_hosts 或其他文件。

entries.en: Connections use Windows' built-in OpenSSH client with ArkDeck's own pinned host key; your known_hosts file and SSH config are not used.
entries.zh-Hans: 连接使用 Windows 内置的 OpenSSH 客户端与 ArkDeck 自己固定的主机密钥；不会使用你的 known_hosts 文件与 SSH 配置。

entries.en: Test the connection first: saving trusts only a host key that was just verified.
entries.zh-Hans: 请先测试连接：保存时只信任刚刚验证过的主机密钥。

entries.en: The server name must not be empty and may have at most 80 characters.
entries.zh-Hans: 服务器名称不能为空，且最多 80 个字符。

entries.en: The host name or IP address is not valid.
entries.zh-Hans: 主机名或 IP 地址格式无效。

entries.en: The SSH port must be between 1 and 65535.
entries.zh-Hans: SSH 端口必须在 1 到 65535 之间。

entries.en: An SSH user name may contain only letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens.
entries.zh-Hans: SSH 用户名只能包含字母、数字、点、下划线和连字符。

entries.en: The build root must be an absolute POSIX path other than /, without . or .. segments.
entries.zh-Hans: 编译根目录必须是非根级的绝对 POSIX 路径，且不能包含 . 或 ..。

entries.en: The credential is empty, too large, or a private key of an unsupported type.
entries.zh-Hans: 凭据为空、过大或私钥格式不受支持。

entries.en: No usable system-default OpenSSH private key was found. Keep an owner-only %USERPROFILE%\.ssh\id_rsa or id_ed25519, or choose a private key.
entries.zh-Hans: 未找到可用的系统默认 OpenSSH 私钥。请配置仅所有者可访问的 %USERPROFILE%\.ssh\id_rsa 或 id_ed25519，或手动选择私钥。

entries.en: The remote build source does not exist or was removed.
entries.zh-Hans: 远端构建源不存在或已被删除。

entries.en: Credential Manager holds no usable credential. Test and save the server again in Settings.
entries.zh-Hans: 凭据管理器中没有可用凭据，请在设置中重新测试并保存。

entries.en: The connection test has expired. Test again before saving.
entries.zh-Hans: 连接测试已过期，请重新测试后再保存。

entries.en: The SSH host key does not match the saved fingerprint. The connection was refused.
entries.zh-Hans: SSH 主机密钥与已保存的指纹不一致，连接已拒绝。

entries.en: The real path of the remote build root changed. The connection was refused.
entries.zh-Hans: 远端编译根目录的真实路径已变化，连接已拒绝。

entries.en: The remote path is outside the saved build root.
entries.zh-Hans: 远端路径超出已保存的编译根目录。

entries.en: The directory has more than 500 visible entries. Configure a more specific build root.
entries.zh-Hans: 目录包含超过 500 个可见条目，请配置更具体的编译根目录。

entries.en: Only a remote file named lib<name>.so can be imported.
entries.zh-Hans: 只能导入名称为 lib<name>.so 的远端文件。

entries.en: A remote native library must be between 64 bytes and 64 MiB.
entries.zh-Hans: 远端动态库必须在 64 字节到 64 MiB 之间。

entries.en: The remote file changed while it was read. Choose it again.
entries.zh-Hans: 远端文件在读取期间发生变化，请重新选择。

entries.en: The remote build source could not be saved safely.
entries.zh-Hans: 无法安全保存远端构建源。

entries.en: Job details are unavailable, so ArkDeck cannot reopen this context.
entries.zh-Hans: Job 详情不可用，ArkDeck 无法重新打开此上下文。

entries.en: This record has no workspace that can be reopened.
entries.zh-Hans: 此记录没有可重新打开的工作区。
